description: 彰化縣縣管區域排水一覽表 [stormwater and drainage] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 彰化縣政府水利資源處. 水利署公告彰化縣縣管區域排水一覽表. Coverage: 彰化縣政府水利資源處. The portal files it under the publisher 彰化縣政府水利資源處. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
